Hi all — quick technical baseline so everyone has the same expectations.

SAML (Redwood SP specifics):
- SP entity: https://private-controlplane.redwood.ai/sp
- Assertion: NameID persistent recommended (transient unsupported for role mapping)
- Required attributes we expect from IdP:
  - email (urn:oid:1.2.840.113549.1.9.1) -> maps to user.email
  - displayName (urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User.displayName)
  - groups (urn:oid:2.5.4.11 OR a custom groups attribute) -> used for role mapping
  - entitlements (optional) -> used for feature-level gating

Example SAML assertion fragment (inline):
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name="groups">
    <AttributeValue>bluewave-engineers</AttributeValue>
  </Attribute>
</AttributeStatement>

Role mapping: our control plane supports mapping group names to Redwood roles (operator/admin/viewer). We provide a mapping table during the MAP step and can apply scoped bindings per VPC tenant.

SCIM (v2) notes:
- Endpoint: https://private-controlplane.redwood.ai/scim/v2/
- Auth: bearer token (we create a scoped provisioning token per tenant)
- PATCH semantics: support RFC7644 patch operations for both users and groups; deprovisioning should use active=false and group remove PATCHs
- Group model: SCIM group.members[].value must contain user id or externalId — we support externalId matching against IdP GUIDs if preferred.

Operational items:
- Please provide IdP metadata XML and a test user/account for the test tenant (we'll keep it scoped to the staging VPC).
- Certificates: we will accept either (a) your IdP-managed TLS cert served from IdP metadata OR (b) a signed metadata blob + fingerprint.

Attaching a CSV with the SAML attributes we rely on: privcp-saml-attrs.csv

Happy to walk through this on the kickoff.

— Dev
